title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Standing and the ProBuild Discount Rate on Ridgeline Tool Rental
content:
A renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account standing moves the ProBuild discount rate of a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement.

**Clause.** Pro Credit standing adds points: when the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account is active and shows no returned payment posted in the last 12 months, 1 point is added; when the account is active and shows one or more returned payments posted in the last 12 months, half a point (0.5) is added; when the renter holds no active Pro Credit account, no point is added.

The points are added to the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement point for point, whatever the ProBuild tier's own rental discount percentage, a tier percentage of zero included.

**Last 12 months.** A returned payment falls in the last 12 months when it is dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the discount is posted.

## Records that decide the points

- The status on the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account record (applied, active, on hold, closed, declined, charged off).
- The returned payment lines on that account, each a payment returned unpaid by the business's bank, and the date each was posted.

## Points table

| Ridgeline Pro Credit account | Returned payments posted in the last 12 months | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | 1 |
| active | one or more | 0.5 |
| on hold, closed, charged off, applied or declined | any | 0 |
| no Ridgeline Pro Credit account | not applicable | 0 |

## The 12-month edge (hypothetical discount posted on 15 September 2026)

| Returned payment dated | Whole calendar months before 15 September 2026 | In the last 12 months |
|---|---|---|
| 16 September 2025 | 11 | yes |
| 15 September 2025 | 12 | no |

## Hypothetical illustration

A ProBuild Silver member (5 percent) with an active Ridgeline Pro Credit account and no returned payment in the window has 1 point added: 6 percent. With one returned payment dated within the window, 0.5 is added: 5.5 percent.
